description: Watches: configure and unfurl free; saving is the paid step. Save a Watch to your key so you can recall it from any door and be told what changed since your last delivery. Saving is the paid step, at the published Watch rate per saved Watch per month (see list_standard_watches terms); with no free paid slot the answer is a plain payment-required with the next step, and nothing is saved or charged. Pass watchId to edit a Watch you saved: that is a new version and costs nothing more. Needs your key. Same content as POST /api/v1/watches.

base.description: The standard Watch to start from: std.hormuz.maritime-operator, std.hormuz.energy-desk, std.us-iran.geopolitical-analyst.

coordinates.description: The coordinates you want to change from the base Watch; every one you leave out takes the base Watch's value. Keys: observer, question, domain, interval, language, depth, cadence, selection, thresholds, permission, delivery. Today the reading honours depth and delivery; the rest are recorded on your Watch and stated as not yet applied.

label.description: Your own name for the Watch.

watchId.description: Edit this saved Watch (a new version) instead of saving a new one.

name: save_watch
